preconditions.description: The dimensions of the chessboard must be between 3 and 1000.
Alice's queen coordinates must be within the bounds of the chessboard.
Bob's king coordinates must be within the bounds of the chessboard.
The target coordinates must be within the bounds of the chessboard.

preconditions.expression: (a_x != b_x or a_y != b_y) and (c_x != a_x or c_y != a_y) and (c_x != b_x or c_y != b_y)
preconditions.description: The king and queen must not occupy the same square, and the target must not coincide with either the queen's or king's position.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' indicating whether Bob can reach the target without getting in check.

postconditions.expression: any((b_x + dx, b_y + dy) for dx in [-1, 0, 1] for dy in [-1, 0, 1] if (b_x + dx, b_y + dy) != (a_x, a_y) and (b_x + dx, b_y + dy) != (c_x, c_y) and (b_x + dx, b_y + dy) not in check_squares)
postconditions.description: Bob can move to an adjacent square that is not in check and not the target square.
